note: enc(s) = uint32be(byte_len(utf8(s))) || utf8(s). No Unicode normalisation. Every string in `reject` MUST be refused rather than encoded with U+FFFD substituted. The two `not-normalised` vectors are canonically equivalent text with deliberately different encodings; an implementation that normalises will produce equal enc_hex.
